question.prompt: Name a video game set in space.
question.criteria: Name a released video game whose main setting includes outer space, spacecraft, or planets beyond Earth. An isolated space-themed level does not qualify.

answers.evidence: Among Us is a social deduction game with settings that include spacecraft and planetary bases.
No Man's Sky is an exploration game about traveling through space and visiting procedurally generated planets.
Starfield is a role-playing game set across inhabited star systems and explorable planets.
Mass Effect follows Commander Shepard on a mission across the galaxy.
Dead Space is a science-fiction horror game set aboard the mining spacecraft USG Ishimura.
Outer Wilds is an exploration game set in a small solar system caught in a time loop.
The Outer Worlds is a role-playing game set in a corporate-controlled space colony.
Alien: Isolation is a survival horror game set primarily aboard Sevastopol space station.
Kerbal Space Program lets players build spacecraft and explore a fictional planetary system.
Elite Dangerous is a spaceflight simulation set in a representation of the Milky Way.
EVE Online is a multiplayer game centered on spacecraft, trade, and conflict across star systems.
FTL: Faster Than Light is a spaceship-management game about crossing space while pursued by a rebel fleet.
Astroneer is a sandbox exploration game set on planets and moons in a fictional solar system.
Homeworld is a real-time strategy game about commanding a fleet on a journey through space.
Freelancer is a space trading and combat game set in the Sirius sector.
FreeSpace 2 is a space combat simulator featuring fighter missions and battles between large spacecraft.
Tachyon: The Fringe is a space combat simulator in which the player works as a mercenary pilot.
Super Mario Galaxy sends Mario through space to explore galaxies and small planets.
Halo: Combat Evolved takes place largely on an artificial ringworld in space.
StarCraft is a real-time strategy game about three factions fighting across the Koprulu sector.
Stellaris is a grand strategy game about building an interstellar civilization.
Space Engineers is a sandbox game about constructing spacecraft, stations, and planetary outposts.
Returnal follows an astronaut trapped in a repeating cycle on the alien planet Atropos.
Star Wars: Squadrons is a starfighter combat game featuring missions in space.
Everspace is a roguelike space shooter in which players pilot a spacecraft through hostile sectors.
Rebel Galaxy is a space adventure centered on commanding a ship in combat and trade.

question.explanation: Space games span exploration, combat, strategy, survival, and platforming. Individual games count, including entries in larger series.
